sources.name: AvatarFace procedural avatars
sources.specialization: flat vector avatar faces generated by project code
sources.admission: Synthetic outputs only; deterministic generator, seed and per-file SHA-256 required.

sources.name: AvatarFace teacher-distilled avatars
sources.specialization: flat vector avatar faces generated by the approved Würstchen v2 teacher
sources.admission: Synthetic teacher outputs only; deterministic captions and seeds, official recipe recorded in the manifest, per-file SHA-256 required.

sources.name: Commissioned original avatar illustrations
sources.specialization: artist-created avatar faces under a written assignment
sources.evidence: Per-asset signed assignment, identity of artist and delivery hash.
sources.admission: Not ingestible until the signed assignment grants training, modification and redistribution.

sources.name: Opt-in avatar contributions
sources.evidence: Per-asset contributor release, age/authority attestation and withdrawal record.
sources.admission: Not ingestible until release and provenance are verified for each asset.
